info.title: FontColle Catalog API
info.summary: Read-only JSON catalog of open-source Google Fonts families.
info.description: FontColle serves its font catalog as static JSON files. Every family carries harvested font-binary data (variable axes, OpenType features, metrics, writing systems) plus Google's classification scores and subjective style tags. No authentication and no rate limit. `id` is the lowercased family name with spaces removed (e.g. "Roboto Slab" -> "robotoslab"). Start from /catalog-slim.json for filtering and ranking; fetch /catalog/{id}.json for a single family's full record.

externalDocs.description: Human- and machine-readable catalog guide (field tables, tag vocabulary, URL params).

get.description: A JSON array of every published family, projected to the fields queries actually filter and rank on. ~2 MB. Start here for style/feature/script queries.
The complete FontRecord[]. ~13 MB. Use only when the slim catalog lacks a field you need (per-axis ranges, named instances, per-family language lists, about/version prose).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Lowercased family name with spaces removed, e.g. robotoslab.

FamilySummary.description: Slim projection of a family. Superset of the fields most queries filter and rank on.

id.description: Lowercased family name with spaces removed; the /catalog/{id}.json key.

category.description: Letterform class: Sans, Serif, Slab, Script, Display, or Graphics. Advance width is not a class here — a monospaced family still carries its letterform class (Roboto Mono is Sans, Courier Prime is Slab). Detect monospace from the /Monospace/Monospace tag or apiCategory instead.

apiCategory.description: Google's own coarser category, e.g. SANS_SERIF, SERIF, DISPLAY, HANDWRITING, MONOSPACE. The fallback monospace signal for families the classification CSV has not reached.

subsets.description: Unicode subsets, e.g. latin, cyrillic, devanagari.

tags.description: Subjective style scores that make mood/feel queries answerable.

FontRecord.description: Full family record. All FamilySummary fields plus per-axis ranges, named instances, per-family language lists, specimen, contrast, version history, and about/designer prose. See https://font.chingru.com/llms.txt for the field-by-field guide.
